purpose: W6-A: establish provider-neutral bank capabilities and a Sber reference adapter contract over the canonical SettlementPlan/bank-operation authority without claiming live credentials or creating bank-specific core semantics.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP specification. This branch stages a finite future scope only; implementation authority requires separate governance review, merge and immutable base-state promotion.
sourceAuditFindings: The exact-main gap map says bank-neutral settlement, holds, callback keys and pending bank operations already exist, but outbound bank consumers, a complete adapter, BillingPort, FinancingPort, bank binding and live finality receipts are absent. This scope must extend those authorities rather than create a second money engine.

config/integration/integration.env.example currently contains BANK_MODE=sandbox, BANK_PROVIDER=sber and BANK_CALLBACK_VERIFY=false. Those example values are configuration examples only and are forbidden as readiness, callback-verification or production-success evidence.

apps/web/lib/platform-v7/integrations/providerRegistry.ts exposes Sber-labelled provider codes for presentation/routing. UI provider metadata is not bank authority and cannot choose a tenant bank binding or advance Settlement.

apps/web/lib/sber-server.ts and apps/web/components/sber-money-rail-panel.tsx are web presentation/proxy surfaces. They remain outside this foundation and cannot be used as proof of provider availability or transaction finality.
Sber Business ID/authentication is a distinct identity concern and must never be reused as settlement, billing, financing or callback authority.
requiredInvariants: Bank/provider choice is an adapter concern. Core SettlementPlan/FinancialObligation semantics remain provider-neutral and no Sber-only field enters canonical money authority.

Capabilities are explicit and versioned, including reserve/release safe-deal-like flow, direct payment/billing, financing/application and callback/reconciliation support; unsupported capability fails closed.
The Sber adapter is a reference adapter whose live state is NOT_ACTIVATED until a real contract, credentials, endpoint configuration and accepted receipt evidence exist.

Adapter request/response contracts use exact minor units, immutable operation/idempotency identifiers and the canonical settlement source versions; no Float money or browser-computed amount becomes authority.
An outbound accepted/queued request is not bank success. Only validated provider receipt/callback bound to exact operation/provider/key/payload fingerprint can advance canonical settlement state.
The same router contract accepts at least two test adapter implementations without changing Settlement core, proving multi-bank substitution rather than one-provider lock-in.
Credential/key/revocation authority remains server-side. Browser, Deal participant or adapter cannot select arbitrary tenant/provider identity or callback key.
Callback replay, mismatched amount/currency/operation/provider, stale key and unknown event fail closed and cannot create duplicate ledger movements.
Example env values, UI provider registries, mock handlers, display panels and historical docs are non-authoritative and cannot satisfy live-provider or multi-bank acceptance.
Sber Business ID or any other authentication/session identity must not be accepted as bank-operation authorization, settlement finality, callback authenticity, billing approval or financing approval.
Financing readiness is a capability/application lifecycle only; adapter availability does not imply approved financing, credit limit or funds.
Billing readiness is separate from safe-deal/reserve-release readiness; one provider capability cannot be silently reused as another.
No live Sber claim is emitted by fixtures, docs or UI until production receipts are evidenced on REG.RU.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, packages/lockfiles and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Contract tests prove the provider-neutral adapter/receipt vocabulary and capability matrix has no Sber-only field in canonical core types.
Two fake/reference bank adapters satisfy the same router and can be swapped without Settlement core changes.
Sber reference adapter fails NOT_ACTIVATED without production credentials/config and never returns fabricated SUCCESS.
Exact amount/currency/idempotency/callback matching and duplicate/replay/mismatched receipt cases are tested fail closed.
Focused regressions prove BANK_MODE/BANK_PROVIDER example configuration, web provider metadata, mocks and Sber Business ID cannot satisfy bank authority or finality checks.
Capability absence separately blocks safe-deal, billing or financing actions rather than degrading to another bank function.
Existing settlement reconciliation/key rotation/hash-chain tests remain green and no new mutation authority bypasses them.
No secret, credential or paid dependency is committed; new mandatory recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
Exact-head CI/review and later REG.RU credentialed acceptance are required before terminal multi-bank/Sber credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Real Sber contract, credentials, endpoints, callback/revocation feeds and production receipts are external dependencies.
W5-A SettlementPlan consumer wiring must exist before adapters can move real canonical obligations.
A second real bank provider is required to prove production multi-bank substitution; test adapters are foundation evidence only.
